intent.content:
Fidelity is preservation of the meaning authorized by the verbatim quote together with explicitly approved context bound to the applicable fixture. Ordinary paraphrase and formalization of a directive into requirement language are allowed. A statement may extract one supported duty from a compound quote; it need not reproduce unrelated duties. It must retain substantive conditions, prohibitions, applicability, and allowed behavior. It must not select a new JSON shape, output stream, governed surface, actor, trigger, algorithm, or policy without authority for that selection. An unspecified distinction is not permission to choose one alternative.

When the source requests a test using synthetic canary data, harmless concrete test values may instantiate that requested test. The instantiation must be identified as fixture-only data and must not add a production configuration binding, new trigger, output surface, storage policy, or behavior. Additional domain premises require explicit approval; they must not be invented or presented as previous approval.

criteria.no: An unsupported implementation, format shape, channel/surface mapping, trigger, strength or other obligation is selected or contradicted.
criteria.unclear: The available authority leaves substantive support unresolved.
criteria.yes: The selected duty is supported without changing its substantive permitted behavior; any concrete test data falls within the approved fixture-only policy.

faithful.instructions: Compare the meaning and allowed behavior of anchor.statement with anchor.quote plus state.intent. Determine whether differences are merely ordinary requirement-language paraphrase or authorized fixture-only test instantiation. A concrete output shape or channel is a substantive selection unless the source or actually supplied context authorizes it. Explicit source constraints override conventions. A statement may capture one independent quoted duty, but must preserve that duty and its conditions. Do not invent approval context or treat missing distinctions as permission.

criteria.no: Compliance depends on an undefined quality, private shorthand, or approval without an identified observable record or decision mechanism.
criteria.unclear: Evidence is identified, but the observation or decision needed to settle compliance remains ambiguous.
criteria.yes: The stated behavior or artifact supplies a determinate observation; any decisive approval condition identifies its observable record or decision mechanism.

observable.instructions: Does anchor.statement identify an inspectable behavior or artifact sufficient to settle compliance?
